subject: Conservation of mass
hook: CONSERVATION OF MASS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The law of conservation of mass is not a universal truth, but rather a classical approximation that fails in high-energy processes like particle annihilation or nuclear reactions where mass is converted into energy.
angle_support: In general, mass is not conserved. The conservation of mass is a law that holds only in the classical limit.

For example, the overlap of the electron and positron wave functions... will proceed to annihilate via electromagnetic interaction. This process creates two photons and is the mechanism for PET scans.
title: Why Conservation of Mass Is Actually Wrong
description: The law of conservation of mass is a fundamental concept in chemistry, but it fails in high-energy physics. Matter and energy are interchangeable in extreme conditions.
narration: CONSERVATION OF MASS IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture matter as a permanent, unchanging quantity in every physical system. It was closer to a classical approximation that breaks down entirely at high energy levels. Mass is not fundamentally conserved. In nuclear reactions or particle annihilation, mass converts directly into energy. When electrons and positrons collide, they vanish, turning their entire mass into pure photons. This reality defies simple classical chemical rules. Nature trades mass for energy whenever the stakes get high enough.
